classification: overnight mean-reversion of the NSE closing-auction price dislocation in F&O cash stocks (sandbox measurement deployment, issue #752)
universe: tradeable F&O stocks (scanner_universe.tradeable_universe, NSE only — indices excluded; every F&O stock is CAS-eligible)
instrument: cash equity, CNC (delivery). MIS is impossible (CAS stocks square off 15:12); stock futures capture only ~4-30% of the auction dip (R71c)
reference_price: last continuous print = frozen LTP after 15:15:00 (the research's 15:14 bar close)
signal: Kite Quote API indicative_close_price <= reference x (1 - threshold_pct/100) at the 15:23:30 decision
selection: deepest dislocation first, top max_positions; floor(capital_per_trade_inr / price) shares
entry_live: CNC LIMIT BUY at indicative close x 1.002 placed into the auction at 15:23:30 (orders accepted 15:20-15:25); filled at the single auction price
entry_sandbox: queued at 15:23:30; CNC LIMIT BUY at the post-auction LTP (= the auction close) at 15:32 — the sandbox fills a marketable LIMIT at LTP
exit: T+1 09:16 CNC SELL MARKET (retry 09:20; boot catch-up until 15:10); quantity from the strategy's own holdings + positions via mode_key
stop_loss: none — the research hold is close -> T+1 open
charges_model: Zerodha equity delivery (verified 2026-10-04): STT 0.1% both sides, NSE txn 0.00307%, SEBI Rs10/cr, stamp 0.015% buy, GST 18% on txn+SEBI, DP Rs15.34 per scrip

parity_target.window: post-CAS 2026-08-03..2026-09-30 (40 entry days) — strategy-faithful replay, threshold 0.5%, top 10/day, Rs50k each
parity_target.entry_convention: BUY at the official auction close (= the sandbox 15:32 fill); SELL at the T+1 09:15 bar close (= the 09:16 exit)
parity_target.charges: Zerodha CNC delivery per round trip (cnc_round_trip_charges): STT 0.1% both sides, stamp, txn, GST, DP Rs15.34
parity_target.caveat: 40 entry days only; CAGR/Sharpe are annualised from 2 months and indicative. Signal uses the FINAL auction close — live decides on the 15:23:30 indicative close (unmeasured until the IEP recorder has 20 sessions). R71b's '79% / 91% win' figures are GROSS and UNCAPPED (every qualifying stock, no 10/day cap, no charges).

llm_context: cas_auction_reversal buys, in cash delivery (CNC), the F&O stocks whose NSE closing-auction price is set at least 0.5% below their last continuous print, and sells them the next morning at 09:16. The bet is that the auction overshoots on order imbalance and the next session's opening auction undoes it. It decides at 15:23:30 from the exchange's indicative closing price and holds overnight with no stop.
live_gate: Operator decision, pre-registered in PLAN.md: flip to live only after 20 sandbox sessions show IEP-signalled names at >= 0.5% making >= +0.40% gross to the T+1 09:15 close with >= 70% gross win. Known live gap (not a stranding risk): the Zerodha holdings mapper drops t1_quantity, so the T+1 exit falls back to the journalled quantity instead of capping to the book (a CNC SELL cannot short).
